description: Use this when the user asks for a video ad, Reel, TikTok ad, UGC video or commercial for their business or product. It renders a finished ad on a real video model, on their brand (real product photos, brand voice), as an mp4 ready to post: timed shots, clean speech, text set in post, no music, captions or end card unless asked. Pass plan_ad’s full output as `creative` (plan_ad turns a one-line ask into the concept). UGC and cinematic plans render from a painted STORYBOARD (a cinematic spot paints a location anchor first, and a hero when someone is on camera); a product-only spot renders from the real product photo, and board:true or foundations:'choose' adds an identity sheet, a moodboard and a board. A plan that fits one clip of the render model renders as one continuous pass; a longer one as STITCHED ACTS (the fewest balanced clips), never time-compressed. Most models cap a clip at 15s and the longest at 30s: dryRun:true shows the act split free, before spending. CAST A SAVED CREATOR with `creator` (list_creators) so the same person stars in every ad; otherwise each render casts a new face. The user’s own pictures (creative.inserts, or `inserts`) are laid in full screen at their seconds. 1–3 min; poll get_job while it renders. Spends credits.

allowGenericProduct.description: proceed even though this brand has NO product photo on file and the ad features a product — the packaging will be INVENTED. Only pass true after telling the user that and hearing they are fine with a generic stand-in

board.description: paint the storyboard board first (default: on for UGC and cinematic spots, off for a product-only commercial); false = render from the text shot list

captions.description: burn the plan's per-scene on-screen words as caption pills. DEFAULT FALSE on every recipe — set true ONLY when the user asks for on-screen text or captions; no recipe turns them on by itself

creative.description: the FULL structured output of plan_ad (must contain video_storyboard)

creator.description: CAST A SAVED CREATOR in this ad — their id from list_creators, or the name you know them by (“Sarah”), or a PRESET AI creator from list_creators presets by exact name or id (free, no generation). Their saved portrait becomes the on-camera identity for the whole spot, so the same face carries across every act and across every ad you render for this brand (casting skips the portrait we would otherwise generate). Omit to let the ad cast a fresh person — EXCEPT for a CREATOR account (onboarded from their own @handle): their own saved likeness is cast by default when the plan has a person on camera and the account is on a paid Hermoso plan (a free account gets a fresh AI person), and the read-back says `default:true`; pass "none" to render without them. Refused for free, with nothing rendered, if the name matches nobody or more than one creator, if an explicitly named creator is cast on a plan with nobody on camera, or if a REAL person is cast on a free plan. Using a real person’s face, likeness or voice confirms you are them or have their consent, take full, unlimited responsibility for its use and will cover any claim against Hermoso (hermoso.ai/terms). Paid plan only; recorded.

dryRun.description: return the routing decision (single pass vs stitched acts, resolved model + act lengths) and the estimated credits the real render reserves, WITHOUT submitting a render — free, nothing charged

durationSeconds.description: total ad length in seconds, 4–180 (clamped). Omit to keep the plan’s own length, almost always right: this only RE-TIMES the authored board; to change the ad’s length, re-run plan_ad with durationSeconds. A length that fits ONE clip renders in one pass; longer is stitched from acts of the model’s clip maximum (15s on most, 30s on the longest-clip one), remainder last. dryRun:true shows the split free.

endCard.description: append the branded end card. DEFAULT FALSE on every recipe — set true ONLY when the user asks for an end card (a clone of a video that had none should not grow one)

faceRoute.description: 'face_lane' records the user's statement "I own the rights to this face" for the real person in their reference (paid plans; the likeness terms apply). Set it only when the user picked that option after a render said it could not use that face, and send the same request again; it then renders through Hermoso's face library at the normal price. Never set it on your own. The other options are a different `model` or one of the user's saved `creator`s.

foundationImages.description: images a foundations:'choose' call returned, reused as-is (not repainted)

foundations.description: product commercial / cinematic: 'choose' paints ONLY the foundations (identity sheet + four-up moodboard, or hero + location) and returns them, no video — then call again with moodboardPick + foundationImages

inserts.description: the user's own screens laid over the finished video at these seconds, as a card over the playing footage by default (look 'full' covers the frame, only when asked), sound running underneath (about 2 credits). The film always opens and ends on moving footage. Omit to use plan_ad's creative.inserts; [] renders without them. plan_ad with inserts writes the board around them.

end.description: second it ends: at most 2 s after start (2.5 s full-screen), never in the last 1.5 s of the film

image.description: an https or upload_file URL, a Library id (L0, L1…) or a local path on the CLI

kind.description: screen (default): an app, a page, a dashboard, a document, a review, a chart. photo: a person, a product or a place, which is NOT laid over the video (a product photo goes in as the brand's product photo, a person to star as a saved creator)

look.description: card (default): a rounded card over the upper middle of the footage, which keeps playing. full: covers the whole frame, ONLY when the user asked for full-screen

start.description: second it appears (never before 1 s: the film opens on moving footage)

lockup.description: brand wordmark + tagline composited over the closing seconds. DEFAULT FALSE — set true ONLY when the user asks for branding on the close

model.description: video model id from hermoso_capabilities (default: the engine the router picks for the plan: seedance-2.5 for every ad, a person talking to camera included). Naming one is a DELIBERATE pick — the server asks before ever swapping it (no silent fallback)

moodboardPick.description: which moodboard panel (1-4, left to right, top to bottom) the storyboard follows; default 1

music.description: music bed: OFF unless asked. true = the plan's own music line; or the bed in words ('lo-fi jazz, brushed drums'); false = none

resolution.description: '1080p' default; '480p'/'720p' cheaper drafts, '4k' premium (more credits). A model renders only the tiers in its own `resolutions` list in hermoso_capabilities (the 30s model tops out at 720p); a tier it lacks renders at its best one without a word, so check before promising 1080p or 4k.

font.description: sans|serif|elegant|condensed|hand or any Google Fonts family

textStyle.description: THE LOOK of captions and the end card, only with captions or endCard and only when the user described one: the look in WORDS ("chunky yellow comic letters, purple outline"), a preset (editorial: big serif title + small italic line; bold: condensed caps, outline; minimal; handwritten; boxed; pill, the default), or fields. "TITLE · small line" puts the part after the dot on a second line.

ttsVoice.description: voiceover voice name (e.g. Rachel / George) when the plan voices over
